title: Chapter 160
text:
Northern Continent, Overmera Headquarters.

"Southern Continent's Green Valley Town was attacked, and we lost this territory. The last news was an hour ago. Liu Cheng died in battle, and Balsas and Xiao Rui retreated. There's no new news yet, so it's probably not going well."

An exquisite crystal wine glass fell to the ground, and the red wine left a blooming rose on the expensive handmade carpet of Ordina. Big Boss Delot breathed heavily like a bear. His body was about the same size as a bear, so his nickname was Overmera's White Bear.

This was Delot's study room. He had a violent temperament, so the bookshelves were not filled with books, but with all kinds of guns, ammunition, daggers, and swords. It was like a small armory.

"Who dared to touch our people?!" Delo glared at them.

A tall, middle-aged man was sitting in front of the desk. He was wearing a suit that looked like a suit, but the details were different. He was wearing a pair of gold-rimmed glasses, and the gold-plated glasses were hanging on his ears. If one ignored the strong muscles that supported the suit, this person looked like a scholar.

Overmera's second leader, Xiao Jin.

Xiao Jin held the tablet computer with one hand and said lightly, "There are two enemies. One is a warlord from Southern Continent, called Lu Cheng."

"I've heard of his name before. He's one of the armed forces gathered in Southern Continent. I want him to pay blood for blood. Overmera must take revenge!"

Delot slammed the table and asked, "Who's the other person?"

"Dark Net's Meritorious Assassin, Black Phantom."

"Get him …" Delot paused after saying three words. He reacted, and his face darkened. "How did we get him involved?"

Black Phantom, a legendary assassin who came and went like a shadow. Delot was very wary of this kind of lone wolf. Overmera was a big family, and they were most afraid of legendary assassins like Black Phantom. If he went crazy and tried to assassinate the middle-level members of the family, it would be impossible to guard against.

Although Delot was impulsive, he knew who he could mess with and who he could not. He could deal with Lu Cheng without hesitation. Lu Cheng's forces were in Southern Continent, so it was impossible for him to affect the Overmera headquarters in Northern Continent. However, Black Phantom was different. He was a lone wolf who could come to Northern Continent. Even Liu Cheng was killed. whether the experts in the family could pose a threat to Black Phantom was still a question.

Furthermore, Black Phantom's whereabouts were unpredictable. Without a huge intelligence network, they could not even find him. The organization that he worked for was the world's largest intelligence network. Delot felt that he would be treated as a fool if he asked the Dark Net for help to deal with people from the Dark Net.

Overall, making an enemy out of Black Phantom was not a wise choice. Delot could only suppress the anger in his heart and find an excuse. "Investigate the reason why Black Phantom intervened. Don't mess with him first."

Xiao Jin nodded. His face was expressionless, and no one could tell what he was thinking.

Delot had a bad temper. He pointed at Xiao Jin's face and shouted, "You better solve your son's problem quickly. The war is coming. I don't want to have anything to do with the Germinal Organization at this time."

Xiao Jin pushed his glasses and said lightly, "He's my son. As long as we find him, he will come back obediently."

…

The sky was about to break, and the gunshots in Green Valley Town finally stopped. The stubborn enemies were all dead. Lu Cheng took over Green Valley Town and ordered the soldiers to clean up the battlefield. He restrained the troops from harming any residents.

The residents who had not slept the whole night walked on the streets in fear. They listened to the new owner of the town, Lu Cheng, give a speech in the square. He promised the safety of everyone's lives and property and comforted the residents.

[Invasion of Green Valley Town] mission. The players who chose the defense camp all failed the mission and were dejected.

The battle last night was very intense and crazy. Many players wanted to continue.

Han Xiao also received the mission experience. No matter how small a mosquito was, it was still meat. He crossed his arms and leaned against a house, waiting for Lu Cheng to finish his speech. Beside him were Mad Blade, Angry Sword, and Pork Bun Beat Dog.

Mad Blade Angry Sword was not in a good mood. He was very sad that he could not have Han Xiao to himself.

Pork Bun Beat Dog came over and asked curiously, "I know you. You appeared in Galaxy Times. You are a professional player."

"Oh." Mad Blade Angry Sword's reaction was cold.

"Have you been following Black Phantom?" Pork Bun Beat Dog asked curiously.

Mad Blade Angry Sword did not want to talk to Pork Bun Beat Dog, but as a professional player, he had to pay attention to his image. He could not be too cold, so he nodded.

"Do you know where he came from?"

"His real name is Han Xiao …" Mad Blade Angry Sword said casually. He then reacted and quickly turned his head. Seeing that Han Xiao beside him did not respond, he continued, "He used to serve in Stardragon. I don't know the details, but I know that he is related to a camp called Stardragon Homeland Strategic Defense Bureau."

Pork Bun Beat Dog's eyes lit up. What he wanted to do was to find out the origin of Black Phantom. Mad Blade Angry Sword was the longest follower, so he knew important material that others did not know. He valued it very much. He smiled and said, "Let me introduce myself. I am a video game producer …"

Frenzied Sword was stunned for a moment. Now that the name was mentioned, he finally remembered why Bun-hit-dog's ID looked so familiar. It turned out that Bun-hit-dog was the author of the "XX Adventure Diaries" series. When he played "Tale of Wuxia" in the past, he had also seen Bun-hit-dog's "Tale of Wuxia" adventure diaries.

"Oh, it's you." Mad Blade Angry Sword's face turned serious. He put away his impatience and received Pork Bun's friend request at the same time. He accepted it immediately.

Only with status and fame would people take them seriously. If they were just casual players, Frenzied Sword would not have cared. However, with fame, it was a different story.

Pork Bun Beat Dog said, "I am going to move to Galaxy and make a series. The first episode will be based on the origin of Black Phantom and explore this character's experience and identity. I hope you can give me some material and also appear in the video. We can do the show together." Han Xiao never talked about his origin. Pork Bun Beat Dog set Mad Blade Angry Sword as his target.

"Sure." Mad Blade Angry Sword agreed. This was a win-win situation. If a professional player participated in the show, it would also increase their fame and exposure.

Listening to the two of them discussing behind his back, Han Xiao did not stop them. Mad Blade Angry Sword's knowledge of him was limited. This information could be divulged, and it could also arouse more players' curiosity about him. It was not enough to just keep them in suspense. He had to give them some real information from time to time. This was the reason why he brought Pork Bun Beat Dog.

After comforting the residents of Green Valley Town, Lu Cheng threw the matter to his assistant and came to Han Xiao. He said sincerely, "Black Phantom, thank you for your help. Otherwise, I would not have been able to take down Green Valley Town. It's a pity that Balsas escaped."

"Oh, I killed him."

Lu Cheng's face froze. He slowly nodded. "I'm very grateful. You … really don't want any reward?"

Han Xiao laughed and changed the topic. "Did you notice the strangeness of the refugees?"

At the mention of this, Lu Cheng's face became very interesting. He said in disbelief, "This group of refugees can all come back from the dead. It's unbelievable. I thought they were just normal people. The world is so big, there are so many strange things!"

Lu Cheng did not want to let the refugees join the battle, but the players acted on their own. He quickly discovered the unique characteristic of the players being able to revive. He was shocked. Only then did he understand what Han Xiao meant. This group of people was too special. He had underestimated them. He finally understood why this group of people were not afraid of death. It was because they could not die.

Pork Bun Beat Dog, who was beside them, suddenly felt that this conversation was a little strange. "Refugees? Are you referring to the players? Why would the NPCs think that the revival of the players is strange? Shouldn't they just ignore it? "

Han Xiao's eyes flashed. He pulled Lu Cheng to the side. He did not want the players to hear the following conversation.

"Black Phantom, do you know the origin of this group of refugees?" Lu Cheng asked in surprise.

Han Xiao's tone was natural. "I don't know, but I know that they are very hardworking and only care about profit. Didn't you take down Green Valley Town? You need people to build it. This group of refugees is the best labor force. You can give them missions … jobs."

"But some of the refugees were my enemies before. They are my enemies …"

"They did not help Balsas because they were loyal. You can treat them as mercenaries."
